environment.description: Same container deployed on RHEL 9 host with a custom SELinux type enforcement policy (docserver_t) compiled and loaded via semodule. The policy defines: allow docserver_t docserver_data_t:file { read open getattr }; allow docserver_t docserver_data_t:dir { search read open getattr }; with file context spec /var/lib/docserver/documents(/.*)? system_u:object_r:docserver_data_t:s0. All other file types are denied by default type enforcement. The container runtime (cri-o) is configured with --selinux-enabled and the pod spec includes seLinuxOptions.type=docserver_t.s0. Additionally, the host has a secondary AppArmor profile 'docserver-restrict' loaded in enforce mode that independently denies read on /** except /var/lib/docserver/documents/** and /usr/local/lib/node_modules/** and /proc/self/**. Both MAC systems must independently permit access for any file read to succeed. The Node.js process runs as uid 1001 (non-root) with no additional Linux capabilities.

config.selinux_policy_rules: allow docserver_t docserver_data_t:file { read open getattr }; deny all other types
